item.title: Natsu to 5-tsu no Negaigoto
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: WhiteLily
  • 発売日: 2018-08-19
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ナツと5つの願いごと
  • 英語名: Natsu to 5-tsu no Negaigoto

别名

  • Natsu and Five Wishes

あらすじ

Natsu meets a boy after a long separation since they were young and they get married

only for five days. He fulfills her wishes written on cards she hands to him once per day.

What secret is hidden in Natsu’s mind, and what wish will be handed on the last day…?

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: WhiteLily
  • 発売日: 2016-01-06
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 沙織お嬢様の屈辱
  • 英語名: Saori Ojou-sama no Kutsujoku

别名

  • The Humiliation of Young Lady Saori

あらすじ

When I was in school, I (the protagonist) was bullied by a rich girl named Saori, who humiliated me so badly I dropped out.

A few years later, I abducted her, imprisoned her and r*ped her.

“It’s not over yet. This is my revenge.”

[From DLsite English]
